subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Why Early Investors Stay Loyal
description: Learn Why Early Investors Stay Loyal in one minute.

hook.text: People who profit from a scheme rarely report it — even when they suspect it's fraud.

buildup.text: Early investors receive real returns. Their personal experience overrides any warning signs.

discovery.text: Admitting it's a scam means admitting they profited from friends' and family's losses.

twist.text: Some early investors actively recruit others, shifting from victim to accomplice.

climax.text: This loyalty shield is why many schemes run for years before anyone sounds the alarm.

punchline.text: Profit is the most effective silencer ever invented.

quiz.question: Why do early Ponzi investors rarely report the scheme?
options: They don't know it's a scam
